core_change_summary.description: Updated .github/workflows/build.yml and release.yml to use shallow clone (fetch-depth), parallel matrix builds for macOS and Windows, and actions/cache for dependency caching.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All changes confined to CI workflow YAML files; no application code modified.
